title: Billing you can read from the API, CLI and MCP
items: GET /api/billing answers what the account pays for with an API key: the plan and its subscription, the add-ons, and every team's
The add-ons and the price of a team plan or seat change can be read with an API key too; paying for a change still takes the browser
whk billing, client.billing in the TypeScript SDK and get_billing in the MCP server
